text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Clutching a huge stack of documents,
I hurried down the hallway toward the
Trainer's office.
choice_data_list: (Will I finally be able to pick a ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paralyzed by rookie Trainer anxiety,
I spent all my time over-preparing...
unable to even muster the courage to approach
any horsegirls.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Just then,
a lively commotion reached my ears.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Cheerleading out of nowhere at lunchtime?!
Leave it to Heart,
though—
look at how huge this crowd is getting!!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
She heard someone had a mock race coming up
and wanted to cheer her on!
Heart is seriously so passionate and
sweet~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pumping up the crowd was a dazzling cheer
squad.
Right in the center stood an especially
eye-catching horsegirl—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone!
Are you ready to bring the hype?
Looking down is a total waste! Chin up,
and look at me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Blow away all those bad vibes!
Let's make our heartbeats echo together♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anyone in the racing world knew her
name...
The top prospect hailing from the prestigious
horsegirl academy, Hillesta Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A horsegirl whose debut was eagerly
anticipated by countless fans.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for indulging my little whim,
everyone!
—...Well?
Did it get your hearts racing too?

text_block_list.name: Friend with Upcoming Race
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! That gave me a ton of energy!
Thank you, Heart!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With talent like that,
she must already have a stellar Trainer.
There was no place for me here—or so I thought,
as I gathered my papers and turned on my
heel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoooooooosh...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haha... For a second,
I thought a passionate love letter had flown
my way.
—...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
..."The Correlation Between Muscle Relaxation
and Explosive Top Speed"?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"By reducing air resistance,
eliminating wasted motion,
and exploding energy at the exact moment of
impact... this allows—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—one to compensate for physical handicaps."
...Oh my.
Did you write this?
What incredible passion!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Not at all... It's fascinating.
You're saying this could prevent being
overpowered in a physical clash, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, would you mind lending this to me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry.
I'll make sure to give it back!
And I'll pay you back double...
with interest♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In return,
I'll let you watch me put it into
practice!
It's the perfect chance to gather live data
with your own eyes, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her piercing,
radiant gaze made my heart skip a beat.
If...
my analytical data could truly be of
use...
choice_data_list: Alright... Sure, you can borrow it!
Alright... Sure, you can borrow it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
Then let's go for a run together tomorrow
morning♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: See ya tomorrow, Mr. Audience!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: See ya tomorrow, Ms. Audience!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good morning!
I've committed all your data to memory.
Now then,
let's see what happens with your theory,
shall we?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Can I leave the timing to you?
choice_data_list: Um... Do you mind if I ride alongs...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ride beside me? On that bicycle?
choice_data_list: Yeah...! I want to see your runnin...
Yeah...! I want to see your runnin...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Of course you can. Take a good,
close look♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once she started running,
she never looked back once.
Tearing through the wind,
sharp and powerful—she accelerated.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(—I will turn this theory into wings.
And... I will surpass who I was...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Fighting against my own limits,
eyes fixed ahead—I will charge forward!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I pedaled,
her back only grew further away.
As if she existed in an entirely different
world...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nice work! Haha, you're really out of breath,
aren't you?
I'm sorry,
I just...
got totally caught up in the run.
choice_data_list: No... it's fine. That was the righ...
No... it's fine. That was the righ...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Still, you... you're amazing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For just a single moment,
I felt it for sure. After relaxing,
my whole body acted like a coiled spring...
and snapped forward with pure fluidity.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I haven't learned to fully relax my shoulders
yet,
so it was only for a split second, though.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If we polish this theory further,
it could really work.
I definitely felt something there.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if something comes up again,
would you give me your thoughts?
You have such an interesting perspective...
What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're the best!
See you around the academy♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It struck my heart like a bolt of
lightning.
I no longer needed any reasons or logic to
want to pursue her running.
